_note: Zombie Villager (nqL-uL-Z_7I0iuowlpBDx) custom moveset, director 2026-10-26: no default rules; 1 Zombie Claws when in range (range 1, gate 2, law 40); 2 move toward the opponent while not adjacent (path length >= 3, the same point where the engine's own move stops); 3 end turn. The engine runs the rule list from the top for every action (ai_v2.ts performAIaction), so after each one-hex move rule 1 is checked again. The move cap comes from AP: a round is 100 AP, a move costs 10 and the claws 60, so up to 4 moves still leave the claws affordable. Rules cannot count moves, so a zombie that needs more than 4 steps keeps walking on its remaining AP instead of stopping. Supersedes push/267's two-rule set.
